topic: AI's Impact on Search and Content Strategy
headline: From content creation to content orchestration: How agentic AI changes the role of content strategists.
keyNotes: The article points out that a new kind of artificial intelligence, called "agentic AI," is changing how businesses create their online materials, like articles or videos.

Instead of just making individual pieces of content, the job of content planners (strategists) is shifting towards "content orchestration," which means managing how all the different content pieces work together.
This transformation means that people who plan content will take on new responsibilities in their roles.
Even with these advanced AI tools, the article emphasizes that human oversight – meaning people still need to supervise and guide the AI – remains absolutely essential.
question: The article highlights that "essential human oversight" is still needed even as "agentic AI" transforms how content is made. In your own work, where do you think human judgment and supervision will always be critical, even as new technologies automate more tasks?
